description:
Join a team that powers the business enterprise behind the mission. Freedom supports the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of more than 100 enterprise business systems that enable tens of thousands of government personnel, industry partners, and prospective employees worldwide. Our teams develop, modernize, secure, and operate the applications and services that support workforce management, training, financial operations, acquisitions, security processing, and executive decision-making across multiple secure environments.   

 As part of this program, you will work alongside experts in software engineering, cloud computing, DevSecOps, systems engineering, and enterprise platforms to modernize legacy systems, automate business processes, and deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the user experience. The work you perform will help ensure the organization has the technology, information, and capabilities needed to support its workforce and accomplish its mission. 

 Our mission supports the Government Corporate Management Services (CMS) by providing full life cycle support services through the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of the enterprise corporate applications. These applications are used across the government enterprise and are critical to the daily functions of thousands of users across acquisition, business, finance, HR, training, recruitment, program management, security, logistics and more. Come join our diverse and growing team with lots of opportunities!

 We are seeking a technically savvy Records Transition and Integration Specialist to support the migration of Completed/Final pre-publication resume lifecycle (PRL) records and workflows from a legacy SharePoint site to the FEITH Records Management System. This role will be central to integrating and configuring the FEITH SharePoint Connector to capture and transfer relevant data, supporting the transition to a new FEITH-based new pre-publication module currently under development. In addition to supporting the records migration effort, the selected candidate will design, develop, and enhance Java-based components that preprocess data from multiple source systems for ingestion into the organization’s SV management system. The initial implementation focuses on SharePoint documents, leveraging an existing reusable codebase that is currently in the early stages of development. The successful candidate will complete and extend this framework, ensuring it can support additional data sources and evolving integration requirements.

 The ideal candidate will be a strong Java developer with experience developing enterprise applications and integration solutions. The role will primarily focus on designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining Java-based components that proces s , transform, and prepare data and records for ingestion into enterprise systems. Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, SharePoint, and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products is beneficial.    

 Position Description: 

 
 Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Java-based preprocessing components that transform and prepare records and metadata from multiple source systems for ingestion into the organization's SV management system.   

 Complete and extend the existing reusable Java preprocessing framework, helping evolve it into a modular and extensible solution capable of supporting additional systems, data sources, formats, and ingestion requirements.   

 Develop and maintain integration logic for SharePoint and other source systems, including use of the FEITH SharePoint Connector to capture and transfer relevant documents and metadata.   

 Support the integration and configuration of FEITH components within ingestion workflows, including setup, testing, and initial configuration of the FEITH pre-publication module to align with customer and system requirements.   

 Troubleshoot and investigate application, data, and integration issues by analyzing logs, exceptions, data, database states, and system configurations; identify root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions.   

 Apply strong object-oriented software development practices and design principles to create maintainable, reusable, and scalable Java solutions, with consideration for future integration and cloud modernization efforts.   

 Collaborate with the Technical Lead, development teams, Electronic Records Management Services team, and customer stakeholders to clarify requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and support successful implementation and rollout. 

 Conduct data ingestion activities, including the one-time migration of records into the FEITH system once the new module is operational, and support additional ingestion initiatives as required.   

 Create and maintain technical documentation, including data flows, process models, system designs, and other documentation needed to support development, integration, troubleshooting, and sustainment activities.   

 Provide technical guidance, workflow demonstrations, and light user support to assist with onboarding users to new records management processes and technologies.   

 
 Technology Stack: 

 
 AWS

 SharePoint

 C++

 Records Management Technology (Feith)

 SQL and SQL Server

 Java

 Oracle

 Linux

 Windows

 JIRA

 Confluence

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 TS/SCI with Polygraph   

 Six (6) years of experience in software development/engineering   

 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science or related discipline   
 
 Ten (10) years of additional software development experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree   

 


 Strong hands-on experience developing applications and integration solutions in Java, including object-oriented programming, common software design patterns, and Java concurrency concepts.   

 General understanding of Microsoft environments and enterprise collaboration tools   

 Experience with parsing various file formats including txt, Excel, JSON, XML, and others.   

 Experience using Gitlab for source control and Maven for Java project configuration and build management.   

 Familiarity with SharePoint, including content structures and common workflows.   

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to onboard and train users on a new system.   

 Ability to work independently while collaborating with developers and product support teams.   

 
 
  

 
 Desired Qualifications: 

 
 Experience with FEITH Records Management System or other COTS products.   

 Background in SharePoint migrations or connector tools.   

 Experience supporting enterprise rollouts and managing stakeholder expectations.   

 Understanding of API calls, especially REST.   

 Experience designing and developing modular, reusable, and maintainable software components, with familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD).   

 Experience working with JFrog Artifactory or similar artifact repository tools to publish, retrieve, and manage software artifacts.   

 
 The estimated salary range for this position is between $150,000-$200,000 (annualized USD). This range reflects the typical pay for the role and is one part of the company's comprehensive compensation package. Actual salaries are influenced by several factors, such as location, the individual’s education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract affordability and organizational needs.
